picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four projects under DOE's Genesis Mission, a national AI-for-science initiative spanning 300+ institutions — signaling a major federal bet on AI-accelerated scientific discovery with academia at the center.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven and Stony Brook with building a foundation model for the U.S. electric grid, applying frontier AI directly to critical national infrastructure.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishing a dedicated College of Artificial Intelligence at UNT reflects the scale of private philanthropic investment now flowing into university AI education and research infrastructure.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: A $10 million OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame's AIM for Scale initiative will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers, a concrete real-world deployment of AI for global food security.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's partnership with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education rollouts in the Asia-Pacific region, a bellwether for how universities integrate generative AI at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative extends AI-for-science partnerships into critical minerals and mining, an area central to supply-chain and energy policy.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen-affiliated researchers' graphene-based optical chips promise to replace electrical data transmission with light, a hardware breakthrough that could reshape the energy efficiency of future AI computing.
picks.title: Light Instead of Electricity: Aachen Engineering Award for a Technological Breakthrough | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test case for how AI capability claims are verified and scrutinized by the research community.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computing building, backed by a $40 million gift, marks a major institutional commitment of physical and financial capital to AI education.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: The Australia-first FlexSysAI pilot with CSIRO and the University of Queensland to make data-center AI workloads grid-aware tackles a growing real-world bottleneck: reconciling AI's power demands with grid stability.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets
